# Notation Index {.unnumbered}

The book uses the textbook's notation throughout. Each symbol below links to the
section where it is defined; the last column counts the sections that use it, so
a symbol with a single hit is probably described only in passing.

| Symbol | Meaning | First defined | Sections using it |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|
| $S_t, A_t$ | state and action at time $t$ | [§1.5](../chapters/ch01-introduction.html#sec-ch01-1-5) | 57 |
| $R_{t+1}$ | reward received after step $t$ | [§2.1](../chapters/ch02-multi-armed-bandits.html#sec-ch02-2-1) | 49 |
| $G_t$ | return: discounted sum of future rewards | [§3.3](../chapters/ch03-finite-mdps.html#sec-ch03-3-3) | 32 |

| $v_\pi(s), q_\pi(s,a)$ | state-value and action-value under $\pi$ | [§3.5](../chapters/ch03-finite-mdps.html#sec-ch03-3-5) | 30 |
| $v_*(s), q_*(s,a)$ | optimal state-value and action-value | [§2.1](../chapters/ch02-multi-armed-bandits.html#sec-ch02-2-1) | 13 |
